title: PayPack Price Index
description: Fair price index for a specific AI service, calculated daily from anonymized transaction data.

benchmark.description: Median price (the fair benchmark), in the smallest currency unit (e.g. wei for ETH, cents for USD)

fair_lower.description: Lower bound of fair price range = max(0, P25 - 1.5 × IQR)

fair_upper.description: Upper bound of fair price range = P75 + 1.5 × IQR

pvi.description: Price Volatility Index (%) — how much today's benchmark differs from N days ago

sample_count.description: Number of successful transactions used to compute this index

currency.description: Currency of all price values (e.g. USDC, USD, CNY)
